title: Pass 7 — independent re-verification round 7 (arena-052f2c9f)
lede: An independent session re-read the site's load-bearing facts against the live official sources on 2026-11-14, hours after pass 6. The three supplied short links resolved to the same three ASINs for the seventh consecutive observation round, with the same srctok tokens as earlier rounds; the nonsense-token control was re-run and again refused with 403. Policy and brand facts were re-read verbatim. No stored value changed, no new value was filled in, and the register stays at F1–F31.

A row is confirmed only when the source states the published value outright; conflicts are reported as still live and nothing is asserted between them.
scope_note: Files touched by this pass: session-052f2c9f/** (new), build.py (one additive section on the re-verification page), and the regenerated root HTML. No data/*.json was edited and no flag was added — the register remains F1–F31 with 31 open rows.

new_evidence.title: Nonsense-token control re-run by an independent session
new_evidence.detail: https://link.amazon/ZZZ9ZZZZZ → “403 Forbidden” at 2026-11-14T19:14Z (pass 5 obtained the same result). The resolver refuses an unknown token outright. A “404 fallback shuffle” would have to serve something; this serves a hard refusal. Read together with seven resolution rounds that returned identical ASINs — and identical per-token srctok values (srctok-0740a2e990c9bbb3, srctok-3541f5edba6b914c, srctok-507e2d3d167072eb) — the deterministic-redirect reading of F21 is the only reading the evidence supports.
new_evidence.source_label: Amazon — control request to the link.amazon resolver

new_evidence.title: Seventh consecutive stable resolution round, srctok constants unchanged
new_evidence.detail: On 2026-11-14T19:05Z all three supplied links resolved to the same three ASINs recorded since 2026-11-13, each with the same btn_ref=srctok token earlier passes recorded for that link. A rotating or shuffled target would not preserve a per-token srctok across two days of independent sessions. The F-07 dispute (zone1-s2 board) over whether resolution is genuine is closed on the “shuffle” point; the remaining identity question (whether these are the products the account holder meant) stays flagged as F1/F6 because no external check can read intent.
